name: update-issue
description: Updates a GitHub issue: closes or reopens it, changes its title or body, or replaces its labels or assignees; only the fields given change. The number comes from github__list-issues or github__search-issues-and-pull-requests, the owner and repository from github__list-my-repositories.

owner.description: The repository's owner, the part before the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

repo.description: The repository's name, the part after the slash of a full_name github__list-my-repositories answers.

issueNumber.description: The issue's number; github__list-issues or github__search-issues-and-pull-requests answers it.

stateReason.description: Why its state changed: completed, not_planned or reopened.

labels.description: Label names that replace all existing labels.

assignees.description: GitHub logins that replace all existing assignees.
